quiz.ruleOneQuestion: One question is shown at a time; you can move between questions in any order.
quiz.ruleAutosave: Answers are saved automatically — there is nothing to save by hand.
quiz.ruleTimer: When the time is over the quiz is handed in by itself, and the saved answers are graded.
quiz.ruleLeaving: The clock does not stop if you leave the page; you can come back and continue until the time is over.
quiz.ruleResume: If you leave the page you can come back later and continue where you stopped.

reviewPolicy.NEVER: This quiz shows no review of the answers — only the result.
reviewPolicy.IMMEDIATELY: After handing the quiz in you can go through the answers.
reviewPolicy.AFTER_ATTEMPT: After handing the quiz in you can go through the answers.
reviewPolicy.AFTER_LAST_ATTEMPT: The review of the answers opens after the last attempt.
reviewPolicy.AFTER_DUE_DATE: The review of the answers opens after the deadline.

quiz.startBody: The clock starts now: {{minutes}} min. Once started, it cannot be paused.

quiz.timeUpBody: Your answers are being handed in…
